name: F_final
frozen: 2026-10-19, after E1-E3 (dev only), before E4 and before any v4final / manuscript-holdout scoring in this experiment
selection_rationale: Flag variants (v4/fixed/strict/clean, all representations) were within the seed-replicate noise floor on dev (|dR2| <= 0.002 covered). Text-embedding arms were the only family with a consistent covered gain (E1 svd16 +0.0067, E2 svd16 +0.0040 / svd32 +0.0072, E3 clean +0.0054, chem +0.0036; all CIs include 0) and each beat its DOI-permuted control. N_svd16_clean is chosen as the single primary candidate: directly measured, prompt-template and evaluative-word artefacts removed. Primary comparison: N_svd16_clean vs M2 on covered v4final records (paired, publication-cluster bootstrap). Everything else is secondary/descriptive.
